shots.purpose: Open mid-action: glowing field wraps the food's shell while the core sits cold and dark
shots.claim: in microwave reheating the food's centre can stay cold while the outer parts and the container become hot
shots.evidence: full-bleed dark-field plate: amber wave arcs wrapping a slate food block, one dark core disc untouched, thin teal cavity outline
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the glowing-shell-versus-dark-core mismatch reads immediately

depth.note: field arcs in front of the block plane (kit full-bleed, V11 P1 §4)

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field plate of a slate food block wrapped in amber wave arcs with a cold dark core, teal cavity outline

one_second.relationship: the shell glows while the core stays dark

shots.purpose: State the folk picture: rays beaming straight through the food and lighting its core
shots.claim: the popular picture holds that microwaves cook food from the inside out
shots.evidence: diagram plate: dashed amber rays crossing the whole block, one bright core marked inside-out
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the through-going rays are the information

depth.note: rays in front of the block, core glowing behind them

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field diagram: dashed rays through a food block with a bright core marked inside-out

one_second.relationship: rays pass through and the core cooks first

surprise.evidence: the cutaway shows the field glow dying over the first centimetres while a slow conduction gradient reaches the cold core

depth.note: cutaway opens the block: decay band, conduction arrows, cold core

shots.purpose: Reveal the truth: the field fades within a few centimetres; conduction carries the heat inward
shots.claim: microwaves penetrate only a few centimetres into wet food, so the outer shell absorbs the energy directly and heat reaches the centre by conduction
shots.evidence: cutaway plate: bright decay band near the opened face fading inward, teal conduction arrows, cold core disc
shots.motion_reason: slow drift along the decay band so the fade-out is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field cutaway: field glow fading across the first centimetres, conduction arrows, cold core

one_second.relationship: the field dies fast; conduction is what reaches the core

shots.purpose: Show dielectric heating: the swinging field torques water dipoles and neighbour friction becomes heat
shots.claim: a microwave oven heats food dielectrically: an oscillating electric field torques polar water molecules and molecular collisions dissipate the energy as heat
shots.evidence: diagram plate: amber field axes above and below, teal dipoles flipping between rows, rust heat sparks between neighbours
shots.motion_reason: drift along the dipole row so the flip-and-scrape rhythm is the motion

depth.note: molecular near-field stack: dipole row in front of the field axes

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field molecular diagram: amber field axes, teal dipoles mid-flip, rust sparks between neighbours

one_second.relationship: the field torques dipoles and neighbours scrape heat

shots.purpose: Split liquid against ice: free-flipping dipoles heat; lattice-locked dipoles barely answer
shots.claim: ice absorbs microwave energy far more weakly than liquid water because its molecules are bound in a lattice, which is why defrost cycles use low power
shots.evidence: split plate: liquid side with flipping dipoles and sparks, ice side with lattice-locked rows and grey lock bars
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the flip-versus-locked contrast is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field split: flipping liquid dipoles left, lattice-locked ice rows right under grey lock bars

one_second.relationship: liquid flips and heats; ice stays locked and cold

shots.purpose: Show the field's patchwork: hot spots pile at the rim and the turntable swings the load through them
shots.claim: the oven's energy pattern changes with the food load and tends to concentrate energy near edges, so turntables and stirrers average out the hot spots
shots.evidence: diagram plate: rust hot-spot zones around the block rim, amber field arcs, teal turntable ellipse with the load swinging
shots.motion_reason: drift from the rim patchwork down to the turntable so the averaging reads as one move

depth.note: block plane above the turntable plane reconstructs the cavity's field space

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field plate: rust hot spots on the block rim, amber field arcs, teal turntable below

one_second.relationship: energy piles at the rim; the turntable averages it

shots.purpose: Land the resolved mechanism: the shell heats first, conduction evens it, stirring redistributes the map
shots.claim: microwave heating works at the food's outer shell and conduction plus stirring redistribute the heat; standing and resting food evens the temperature
shots.evidence: payoff plate: the block with one even warm gradient through the shell, teal conduction arrow inward, calm amber glow
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

depth.note: settled field glow behind the even gradient

subject_contract.expected_subject: dark-field payoff: slate block with an even amber gradient, teal conduction arrow, calm glow

one_second.relationship: shell first, then inward; stir and rest even it
